title: 高分翻译背诵上海高考-46

items.zh: 女儿希望妈妈能留一头齐腰长发。
items.en: The daughter hopes her mother will grow waist-length hair.

items.zh: 夜幕降临，三五成群的居民来到公园锻炼身体。
items.en: As night falls, residents in huddles head to the park for exercise.

items.zh: 这个在线课程的教学方式与线下课程非常相似。
items.en: This online course is taught in much the same way as offline ones.

items.zh: 旅居海外多年，归来时才明白，原来我心心念念的地方一直在这里。
items.en: Having resided abroad for many years, I only realized upon my return that the place I had been longing for was here all along.

items.zh: 这家饭店确实很棒，但对我来说太贵了，所以最后我选择了一家名不见经传但性价比更高的饭店。
items.en: The restaurant was truly excellent, but as it was far too expensive for me, I finally opted for a little-known yet a better-value alternative.
